title: The normalized restricted scalar pullback square is the canonical tensor square
statement: Let a and f be as in [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons], and suppose tX,tY satisfy TensorNormalized and lam satisfies PullNormalized. Form the canonical restriction/pullback b from [def-sfb-derived-comap-upper-star-iso]. Let v_T : V_T(1_S) ≅ B_T be exact restriction followed by the single-complex localization comparison. Define c : L_R B_Y ≅ B_X as L_R(v_Y inverse), then b inverse on 1_S, then V_X of the canonical geometric unit comparison, then v_X. The composite b inverse at D_Y M, followed by V_X(lam_M) and tX at L_R M, equals L_R(tY_M), followed by the specified derived tensor pullback comparison and 1 tensor c, for every unbounded M. Tensors and units are those of [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom], and the coefficient identifications are those of [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms]. No flatness of a or B_Y is assumed.

proof.text: The generic tensor-model target is invertible whenever ordinary pullback of P is K-flat. Tensoring the coefficient isomorphism is invertible too, so cancel T_P to get the desired square on such representatives. No tensor with a nonflat coefficient is inverted without a K-flat other factor.

proof.text: Ordinary pullback preserves flat objects by transport of inverse-image flatness along the coefficient isomorphism. The existing generic kFlatMap left-resolution API supplies Qh(P)≅M with K-flat pullback for every unbounded M. Form the two routes as natural transformations, use naturality along this isomorphism and cancel its image under the common source functor.

theorem scalar_tensor_pull_normalization (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (tX : TensorNormalization a X) (tY : TensorNormalization a Y)
    (lam : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X)
    (hX : TensorNormalized a X tX) (hY : TensorNormalized a Y tY)
    (hlam : PullNormalized a f lam) :
  let b := Functor.isoWhiskerRight
      (CondensedRing.leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory Λ' f) (V a X) ≪≫
    CondensedRing.derivedComapUpperStarIso a f ≪≫
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (V a Y)
      (CondensedRing.leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory Λ f).symm
  let vY := (V₀ a Y).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.app
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor (Modules Λ' Y) 0).obj
        (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ' Y))) ≪≫
    DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (V₀ a Y) (.up ℤ) 0).app
        (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ' Y)))
  let vX := (V₀ a X).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.app
      ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor (Modules Λ' X) 0).obj
        (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ' X))) ≪≫
    DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (V₀ a X) (.up ℤ) 0).app
        (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ' X)))
  let c := (L Λ f).mapIso vY.symm ≪≫
    b.symm.app (𝟙_ (DerivedCategory (Modules Λ' Y))) ≪≫
    (V a X).mapIso (CondensedRing.leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso Λ' f) ≪≫ vX
  ∀ M : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ Y),
    b.inv.app ((D a Y).obj M) ≫
        (V a X).map (lam.hom.app M) ≫ tX.derived.hom.app ((L Λ f).obj M) =
      (L Λ f).map (tY.derived.hom.app M) ≫
        ((CondensedRing.leftDerivedUpperStarTensor Λ f).app M).app (B a Y) ≫
        ((L Λ f).obj M ◁ c.hom)
